x_query.oql:
works where date >= (2015-01-01)
  and date <= (2026-08-31)
  and full text has (
    (
      5G or 6G or B5G or RAN or stemmed "5G-Advanced" or stemmed "IMT-2030"
      or stemmed "base station" or stemmed "cellular network"
      or stemmed "radio access network" or stemmed "telecom tower"
    )
    and (
      HIL or stemmed "case study" or stemmed "hardware-in-the-loop"
      or stemmed "market participation" or stemmed "real-world data"
      or demonstration or experiment or field or pilot
    )
    and (
      VPP
      or stemmed "congestion management"
      or stemmed "distribution grid"
      or stemmed "local energy sharing"
      or stemmed "virtual power plant"
      or stemmed "voltage support"
      or microgrid
    )
  )
x_query.url: /works?filter=from_publication_date:2015-01-01,to_publication_date:2026-08-31,fulltext.search:5G|6G|B5G|RAN|%225G-Advanced%22|%22IMT-2030%22|%22base station%22|%22cellular network%22|%22radio access network%22|%22telecom tower%22,fulltext.search:HIL|%22case study%22|%22hardware-in-the-loop%22|%22market participation%22|%22real-world data%22|demonstration|experiment|field|pilot,fulltext.search:VPP|%22congestion management%22|%22distribution grid%22|%22local energy sharing%22|%22virtual power plant%22|%22voltage support%22|microgrid&per_page=10
